	set_variable = {
		name = looting_1_year
		value = 0
	}
}

national_stockpile_state_modifier_clean_subject = {
	every_scope_state = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
		}
		remove_modifier = storing_ammunition
		remove_modifier = releasing_ammunition
		remove_modifier = storing_small_arms
		remove_modifier = releasing_small_arms

			}
		}
		scope:national_stockpile_historic_place = {
			remove_modifier = storing_telephones
		}
	}
	if  = {

			scope:national_stockpile_historic_place = {

			}

#ammunition
flow_storing_ammunition = {
	set_variable = {
		name = stockpiling_ammunition_var_2
		value = 0
	}
    if = {
        limit = {
			ammunition_market_goods_delta > 25 #test
			stockpiling_ammunition_var_state < 1000000
        }
		change_variable = {
			name = stockpiling_ammunition_var_2
			add = ammunition_market_goods_delta_month
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = national_stockpile_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = national_stockpile_historic_place
				scope:national_stockpile_historic_place = {
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_ammunition_state_1
						add = root.var:stockpiling_ammunition_var_2
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
storing_ammunition_1 = {
	change_variable = {
		name = store_ammunition_time
		add = 1
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = ammunition_store_month
		subtract = 1
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = stockpiling_ammunition_var_2
		value = 0
	}
	if = {
		change_variable = {
			name = stockpiling_ammunition_var_2
			add = ammunition_store_quantity_1_month
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = stockpiling_ammunition_var_2
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = national_stockpile_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = national_stockpile_historic_place
				scope:national_stockpile_historic_place = {
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_ammunition_state_1
						add = root.var:stockpiling_ammunition_var_2
					}
				}
			}

		}
	}

	############
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:store_ammunition_time = var:ammunition_store_month_fixe
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = store_ammunition_time
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_status
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = store_ammunition_time
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_quantity_1_year
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = release_ammunition_var_1
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_month
			value = 12
		}
		every_scope_state = { 
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				remove_modifier = storing_ammunition
			}
		}
		national_stockpile_state_modifier_clean = yes #clear general en meme temps
	}
}
releasing_ammunition_1 = {
	change_variable = {
		name = release_ammunition_time
		add = 1
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = ammunition_release_month
		subtract = 1
	}

	############
	if = {

		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_quantity_1_year
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = release_ammunition_var_1
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {

buy_sell_ammunition_on_international_market = {
	#Buy
	if = {
		limit = {
			stockpiling_ammunition_var_state < ef_ai_set_ammunition_reserve_sc
			or = {
				has_building_produces_ammunition = 0
				market.mg:ammunition.market_goods_cheaper > 0.5
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = buy_ammunition_on_international_market_1
			value = quantity_ammunition_buy_on_global_market #quel quantité peut acheter le pays avec 10% de la gold reserve
		}
		change_global_variable = {
			name = stockpiling_ammunition_var_global
			subtract = var:buy_ammunition_on_international_market_1
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = national_stockpile_place
					var:stockpiling_ammunition_state_1 < 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_ammunition_state_1 #stockpiling_ammunition_var_state_1
					value = 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = national_stockpile_place
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_ammunition_state_1 #stockpiling_ammunition_var_state_1
					add = root.var:buy_ammunition_on_international_market_1
				}
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = buy_ammunition_on_international_market_1
			multiply = ammunition_global_market_goods_price
			multiply = money_value_rapported_inflation
		}
		# add_treasury = {
		# 	subtract = var:buy_ammunition_on_international_market_1 #ai_cheat
		# }
	}
	#Sell
	if = {
		limit = {
			or = {
				stockpiling_ammunition_var_state > ef_ai_set_ammunition_reserve_sc
				gold_reserves_var < gold_reserves_50 #gold reserve inf à 50% du max
			}
			has_building_produces_ammunition = 1 #est ce que je produit la ressource
			not = {
				var:ammunition_release_status = 1
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = sell_ammunition_on_international_market_1
			value = sell_ammunition_on_international_market_1_sc
		}
		change_global_variable = {
			name = stockpiling_ammunition_var_global
			add = var:sell_ammunition_on_international_market_1
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = national_stockpile_place
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_ammunition_state_1 #stockpiling_ammunition_var_state_1
					subtract = root.var:sell_ammunition_on_international_market_1
				}
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = sell_ammunition_on_international_market_1
			multiply = ammunition_global_market_goods_price
			#some cheat multiply = money_value_rapported_inflation
		}
		# add_treasury = {
		# 	add = var:sell_ammunition_on_international_market_1
		# }
	}
	ef_ai_ammunition_store_release = yes
}

			}
			has_building_produces_fabric = 1 #est ce que je produit la ressource
			not = {
				var:fabric_release_status = 1
			}
		}
		set_variable = {

		}

			name = stockpiling_fabric_var_global
			add = var:sell_fabric_on_international_market_1
		}

					has_modifier = national_stockpile_place
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_fabric_state_1 #stockpiling_fabric_var_state_1

				}

				}

				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_coal_state_1 #stockpiling_coal_var_state_1
					add = root.var:buy_coal_on_international_market_1
				}
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = buy_coal_on_international_market_1
			multiply = coal_global_market_goods_price
			multiply = money_value_rapported_inflation
		}
		# add_treasury = {
		# 	subtract = var:buy_coal_on_international_market_1 #ai_cheat
		# }
	}
	#Sell
	if = {

				stockpiling_coal_var_state > ef_ai_set_coal_reserve_sc
				gold_reserves_var < gold_reserves_50 #gold reserve inf à 50% du max
			}

			not = {
				var:coal_release_status = 1
			}
		}
		set_variable = {

			}
		}

		}

		}

				}
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = buy_fertilizer_on_international_market_1
			multiply = fertilizer_global_market_goods_price
			multiply = money_value_rapported_inflation
		}

		# }

		}
		change_global_variable = {
			name = stockpiling_fertilizer_var_global
			add = var:sell_fertilizer_on_international_market_1
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = national_stockpile_place
				}
				change_variable = {

ef_ai_ammunition_store_release = {
	#store
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = has_national_stockpile
			market = {  #pas de stockpile forcé d'un bien car le pays l'achete sur le marché global mais si surproduction d'un bien alors il peut le stocké pour le revendre cela pourrai etre différent pour le petrole ou l'on pourrai artificiellement créer de la demande pour favorisé le développement du secteur pétrolier
				mg:ammunition = { ammunition_market_goods_delta_month >= 4000 }
			}
			var:ammunition_release_status = 0
			var:ammunition_store_status = 0
			not  = {
				is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
			}
			stockpiling_ammunition_var_state < 1000000
			#stockpiling_ammunition_var_state < ef_ai_set_ammunition_reserve_sc
			# NOT = { #test pck le pays ne doit plus utiliser de tresori pour achter les bien
			# 	or  = {
			# 		has_modifier = declared_bankruptcy
			# 		country_credit > 0
			# 		var:economic_crisis = 1
			# 		var:currency_crisis = 1
			# 		var:central_bank_bankruptcy = 1
			# 		var:financial_crash = 1
			# 	}
			# }
		}

		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_quantity
			value = ai_ammunition_store_quantity_1Y
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_month
			value = 12
		}
		##################################

		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_status
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = store_ammunition_var_1
			value = ammunition_store_quantity_1_week
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_month_fixe
			value = var:ammunition_store_month
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				remove_modifier = storing_ammunition
				add_modifier = {
					name = storing_ammunition
					multiplier = ammunition_store_quantity_1_week
				}
			}
		}

		#reset release
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_status
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_quantity
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	#release
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = has_national_stockpile
			market.mg:ammunition.market_goods_cheaper < -0.5
			var:ammunition_release_status = 0
			var:ammunition_store_status = 0
			not  = {
				is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
			}
			stockpiling_ammunition_var_state > ai_ammunition_release_quantity_1Y
		}

		#Scripted GUI transformed
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_quantity
			value = ai_ammunition_release_quantity_1Y
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_month
			value = 12
		}
		##################################

		set_variable = {
			name = release_ammunition_var_1
			value = ammunition_release_quantity_1_week
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_status
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_month_fixe
			value = var:ammunition_release_month
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_release_quantity_1_year
			value = ammunition_release_predicted
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				remove_modifier = releasing_ammunition
				add_modifier = {
					name = releasing_ammunition
					multiplier = ammunition_release_quantity_1_week
				}
			}
		}

		#reset store
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_status
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ammunition_store_quantity
			value = 1000
		}
	}
}

			var:sulfur_release_status = 0
			var:sulfur_store_status = 0

				is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
			}

		}

			value = ai_sulfur_release_quantity_1Y
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = sulfur_release_month
			value = 12
		}
		##################################

		set_variable = {

			value = sulfur_release_quantity_1_week
		}
		set_variable = {

			value = var:sulfur_release_month

				}
				remove_modifier = storing_oil
				add_modifier = {
					name = storing_oil
					multiplier = oil_store_quantity_1_week
				}
			}
		}

		#reset release
		set_variable = {
			name = oil_release_status
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = oil_release_quantity
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	#release
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = has_national_stockpile
			market.mg:oil.market_goods_cheaper < -0.5
			var:oil_release_status = 0
			var:oil_store_status = 0
			not  = {
				is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
			}
			stockpiling_oil_var_state > ai_oil_release_quantity_1Y
		}

		#Scripted GUI transformed
		set_variable = {
			name = oil_release_quantity
			value = ai_oil_release_quantity_1Y
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = oil_release_month
			value = 12
		}
		##################################

		set_variable = {
			name = release_oil_var_1
			value = oil_release_quantity_1_week
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = oil_release_status
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = oil_release_month_fixe
			value = var:oil_release_month
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = oil_release_quantity_1_year
			value = oil_release_predicted
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				remove_modifier = releasing_oil
				add_modifier = {
					name = releasing_oil
					multiplier = oil_release_quantity_1_week
				}
			}
		}

		set_variable = {

		}

		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_store_quantity
			value = ai_automobiles_store_quantity_1Y
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_store_month
			value = 12
		}
		##################################

		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_store_status
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = store_automobiles_var_1
			value = automobiles_store_quantity_1_week
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_store_month_fixe
			value = var:automobiles_store_month
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				remove_modifier = storing_automobiles
				add_modifier = {
					name = storing_automobiles
					multiplier = automobiles_store_quantity_1_week
				}
			}
		}

		#reset release
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_release_status
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_release_quantity
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	#release
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = has_national_stockpile
			market.mg:automobiles.market_goods_cheaper < -0.5
			var:automobiles_release_status = 0
			var:automobiles_store_status = 0
			not  = {
				is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
			}
			stockpiling_automobiles_var_state > ai_automobiles_release_quantity_1Y
		}

		#Scripted GUI transformed
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_release_quantity
			value = ai_automobiles_release_quantity_1Y
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_release_month
			value = 12
		}
		##################################

		set_variable = {
			name = release_automobiles_var_1
			value = automobiles_release_quantity_1_week
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_release_status
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_release_month_fixe
			value = var:automobiles_release_month
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_release_quantity_1_year
			value = automobiles_release_predicted
		}
		every_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
					is_capital = yes
				}
				remove_modifier = releasing_automobiles
				add_modifier = {
					name = releasing_automobiles
					multiplier = automobiles_release_quantity_1_week
				}
			}
		}

		#reset store
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_store_status
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = automobiles_store_quantity
			value = 1000
		}
	}
}
ef_ai_telephones_store_release = {
	#store
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = has_national_stockpile
			market = {  #pas de stockpile forcé d'un bien car le pays l'achete sur le marché global mais si surproduction d'un bien alors il peut le stocké pour le revendre cela pourrai etre différent pour le petrole ou l'on pourrai artificiellement créer de la demande pour favorisé le développement du secteur pétrolier
				mg:telephones = { telephones_market_goods_delta_month >= 4000 }
			}
			var:telephones_release_status = 0
			var:telephones_store_status = 0
			not  = {
				is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
			}
			stockpiling_telephones_var_state < 1000000
			#stockpiling_telephones_var_state < ef_ai_set_telephones_reserve_sc
			# NOT = { #test pck le pays ne doit plus utiliser de tresori pour achter les bien

			# 		has_modifier = declared_bankruptcy
			# 		country_credit > 0
			# 		var:economic_crisis = 1
			# 		var:currency_crisis = 1
			# 		var:central_bank_bankruptcy = 1
			# 		var:financial_crash = 1
			# 	}
			# }
		}

		set_variable = {
			name = telephones_store_quantity
			value = ai_telephones_store_quantity_1Y
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = telephones_store_month
			value = 12

			value = 1000

		}

			name = release_telephones_var_1
			value = telephones_release_quantity_1_week
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = telephones_release_status
			value = 1
		}

#ammunition
buy_ammunition_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_buy_ammunition_1
		save_scope_as = seller_country
	}

	scope:seller_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			capital = {
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:seller_country.var:ammunition_sell_price_by_price
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_ammunition_state_1
					subtract = scope:seller_country.var:ammunition_sell_1
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ammunition_sell_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ammunition_sell_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ammunition_sell_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_ammunition_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_ammunition_1
				value = 0
			}
			clear_variable_list = order_sell_ammunition_1

			scope:player_country  = {
				capital = {
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:ammunition_buy_price_by_price
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_ammunition_state_1
						add = scope:player_country.var:ammunition_buy_1
					}
				}

				set_variable = {
					name = ammunition_buy_1
					value  = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = ammunition_buy_price
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = ammunition_buy_price_by_price
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = buy_ammunition_in_gold_1
					value = 0
				}

					value = 0

			is_player = yes

			is_player = yes

sell_artillery_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_sell_artillery_1
		save_scope_as = buyer_country
	}

	scope:buyer_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			capital = {
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					subtract = scope:buyer_country.var:artillery_buy_price_by_price
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_artillery_state_1
					add = scope:buyer_country.var:artillery_buy_1
				}
			}

			set_variable = {
				name = artillery_buy_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = artillery_buy_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = artillery_buy_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = buy_artillery_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {

			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_pound_sterling_currency
			}
			capital = {
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
					subtract = scope:buyer_country.var:aeroplanes_buy_price_by_price
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_aeroplanes_state_1
					add = scope:buyer_country.var:aeroplanes_buy_1
				}
			}

			set_variable = {
				name = aeroplanes_buy_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = aeroplanes_buy_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = aeroplanes_buy_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = buy_aeroplanes_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = buy_aeroplanes_1
				value = 0
			}
			clear_variable_list = order_buy_aeroplanes_1

			scope:player_country  = {
				capital = {
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1

					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_aeroplanes_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:aeroplanes_sell_1
					}
				}

				set_variable = {
					name = aeroplanes_sell_1
					value  = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = aeroplanes_sell_price
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = aeroplanes_sell_price_by_price
					value = 0
				}

	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}

		variable = order_buy_grain_1
		save_scope_as = seller_country
	}

	scope:seller_country = {
		#dinar

			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}

				name = grain_sell_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = grain_sell_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {

				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_grain_in_gold_1

			is_player = yes

	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}

		variable = order_sell_groceries_1
		save_scope_as = buyer_country
	}

			is_player = yes

	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}

		variable = order_buy_silk_1
		save_scope_as = seller_country
	}

sell_silk_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_sell_silk_1
		save_scope_as = buyer_country
	}

	scope:buyer_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {

				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_silk_state_1
					add = scope:buyer_country.var:silk_buy_1
				}

				value  = 0

				name = silk_buy_price_by_price

#coal
buy_coal_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_buy_coal_1
		save_scope_as = seller_country
	}

	scope:seller_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			capital = {

					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:seller_country.var:coal_sell_price_by_price
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_coal_state_1
					subtract = scope:seller_country.var:coal_sell_1
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = coal_sell_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = coal_sell_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = coal_sell_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_coal_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_coal_1
				value = 0
			}
			clear_variable_list = order_sell_coal_1

			scope:player_country  = {
				capital = {
					change_variable = {

#rubber
buy_rubber_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_buy_rubber_1
		save_scope_as = seller_country
	}

	scope:seller_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			capital = {
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:seller_country.var:rubber_sell_price_by_price
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_rubber_state_1
					subtract = scope:seller_country.var:rubber_sell_1
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = rubber_sell_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = rubber_sell_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = rubber_sell_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_rubber_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_rubber_1
				value = 0
			}
			clear_variable_list = order_sell_rubber_1

			scope:player_country  = {
				capital = {
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:rubber_buy_price_by_price
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_rubber_state_1
						add = scope:player_country.var:rubber_buy_1
					}
				}

				set_variable = {
					name = rubber_buy_1
					value  = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = rubber_buy_price
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = rubber_buy_price_by_price
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = buy_rubber_in_gold_1
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = buy_rubber_1
					value = 0

		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country

#tools
buy_tools_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_buy_tools_1
		save_scope_as = seller_country
	}

	scope:seller_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			capital = {
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:seller_country.var:tools_sell_price_by_price
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_tools_state_1
					subtract = scope:seller_country.var:tools_sell_1
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = tools_sell_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = tools_sell_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = tools_sell_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_tools_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = sell_tools_1
				value = 0
			}
			clear_variable_list = order_sell_tools_1

			scope:player_country  = {
				capital = {
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:tools_buy_price_by_price
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_tools_state_1
						add = scope:player_country.var:tools_buy_1
					}
				}

				set_variable = {

sell_tools_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_sell_tools_1
		save_scope_as = buyer_country
	}

	scope:buyer_country = {
		#dinar

			is_player = yes

sell_automobiles_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_sell_automobiles_1
		save_scope_as = buyer_country
	}

	scope:buyer_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			capital = {
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					subtract = scope:buyer_country.var:automobiles_buy_price_by_price
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_automobiles_state_1
					add = scope:buyer_country.var:automobiles_buy_1
				}
			}

			set_variable = {
				name = automobiles_buy_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = automobiles_buy_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = automobiles_buy_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = buy_automobiles_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = buy_automobiles_1
				value = 0
			}
			clear_variable_list = order_buy_automobiles_1

			scope:player_country  = {
				capital = {
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						add = scope:player_country.var:automobiles_sell_price_by_price

sell_radios_order_in_currency = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_player = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = player_country
	}
	random_in_list = {
		variable = order_sell_radios_1
		save_scope_as = buyer_country
	}

	scope:buyer_country = {
		#dinar
		if  = {
			limit = {

			}

					name = stockpiling_radios_state_1

				}
			}

				name = radios_buy_1
				value  = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = radios_buy_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = radios_buy_price_by_price
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = buy_radios_in_gold_1
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = buy_radios_1
				value = 0
			}
			clear_variable_list = order_buy_radios_1

					value = 0
